results.criterion: After opening GIS and loading an available Surveyor layer, the layer legend displays a Display Settings control.
steps_taken: Started at the launcher and opened GIS.
Opened the available Surveyor layer setup and added the layer with its default options.
Confirmed the Surveyor layer legend displayed the Display Settings control.
results.reason: The Surveyor - Service legend visibly included Display Settings. An accidentally opened Crowd setup dialog was cancelled without adding that layer.

results.criterion: Opening Display Settings displays a Show linked sites control with an identifiable checked or unchecked initial state.
steps_taken: Returned to the launcher and captured the initial state.
Opened GIS, then opened Display Settings for Surveyor - Service.
Confirmed Show linked sites was visible and checked.
results.reason: Display Settings showed Show linked sites in the checked state.

results.criterion: Changing Show linked sites to the opposite state visibly changes the control to that new checked or unchecked state.
steps_taken: Returned to the launcher and opened GIS.
Opened Display Settings and confirmed Show linked sites was initially checked.
Clicked Show linked sites once and confirmed it became unchecked.
After capturing the decisive unchecked state, restored it to checked for cleanup.
results.reason: The control visibly changed from checked to unchecked. Cleanup restored the initial checked state.

results.criterion: Restoring Show linked sites to its initial state, closing and reopening Display Settings, displays the same initial state.
steps_taken: Returned to the launcher and opened GIS for this criterion.
Opened Display Settings and confirmed Show linked sites was initially checked.
Changed it to unchecked, then restored it to checked.
Closed Display Settings with Escape and reopened it.
Confirmed Show linked sites remained checked after reopening.
After the decisive screenshot, closed the panel and removed the Surveyor layer added for testing.
results.reason: After restoring the initially checked state, closing and reopening Display Settings showed it still checked. The test-added Surveyor layer was removed during cleanup.

conciseReport: All four acceptance criteria passed. The Surveyor layer legend showed Display Settings; Show linked sites began checked, changed to unchecked, and was restored. Closing and reopening Display Settings retained the checked state. The test-added Surveyor layer was removed after testing.
reason: Completed the selected live handoff and staged criterion-specific browser evidence.
